Mia (Marketing): Quick sync — post-launch nurture for the Benchmark report + webinar. Need final segmentation, cadence, and inbound routing rules. Who's available to lock this down today?

Liam (Growth): Proposing 3 segments: 1) Engaged product users (opened >2 emails or visited docs in last 14d), 2) Product-curious (visited docs but no trial), 3) Cold (no activity 90d). Cadence idea: seg1 = 5-touch over 3 weeks, seg2 = 4-touch over 4 weeks, seg3 = 1 re-engage + suppression.

Jordan (Content): Draft subject lines: A) "See the new LLM benchmark that cut inference cost by 3x" B) "How teams cut latency & cost — live demo + report". Suggest A/B test for seg1 only. Short preheader variants ready.

Rachel (Ops): SQL for seg1 (rough): `select distinct user_id from email_events where opens > 2 and last_seen >= now() - interval '14 days'` — will add sales-score > 50 filter for MQL routing. Will push lists to HubSpot when confirmed.

Emma (Design): Creative: hero + 2 CTAs (Read report / Register for webinar). I'll upload hero banner + mobile variants to Figma by EOD. Need copy length constraints for email clients.

Mia (Marketing): Routing rules: webinar registrants -> tag `webinar-registered`; if company_size > 50 or lead_score > 70 then route to AE queue. If registers + attends -> mark `sales-priority` and create HubSpot task. @Liam please confirm numeric thresholds.

Liam (Growth): Confirmed. Also: suppress anyone who unsubscribed or submitted a 'do not market' flag in last 6 months. Enforce throttle: max 1 campaign email per 24h and 3 per 7d.

Jordan (Content): UTM plan for all links: `?utm_campaign=benchmark_q3&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_content={variant}` — ensure landing pages capture `utm_content` for the A/B variant.

campaign-bot: campaign-bot scheduled: created draft campaign in HubSpot "Benchmark Q3 - Nurture" — initial send scheduled 2026-04-02 09:00 PST. -> Draft status. :white_check_mark:

Mia (Marketing): Great. A/B subject test only for seg1. Owners: copy=Jordan, design=Emma, ops=Rachel, growth=Liam. Quick checklist before send: copy, creative, LP tracking, suppression lists, routing webhooks. Any blockers?

Liam (Growth): No blockers. I'll configure A/B (split 50/50) and set open-rate target 20% for seg1. Will monitor first 2 hours and pause if spam complaints spike.

Rachel (Ops): Uploaded lists to HubSpot and created suppression list named `suppress_postlaunch_optouts`. I'll run an internal dry send to 100 addresses tomorrow morning for rendering and deliverability checks.

Mia (Marketing): Thanks — I'll drop a calendar invite for post-launch review on 2026-04-05 10:00 PT. We'll review opens, CTR, registration rate, and lead routing outcomes. :calendar: Feel free to add agenda items.
